1.consolidated_definition: Desorden nervioso que sufren los gallos, cuyos síntomas son parálisis muscular, convulsiones y la muerte, que se produce por insuficiencia cardiaca. Caguas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Nervous disorder affecting roosters, characterized by muscular paralysis, convulsions, and death resulting from cardiac insufficiency, also known as Caguas.
